svg.text: Check each step before moving on

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 1 python zbx-cli.py hosts → lists your hosts (proves user + permissions)

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 2/3 Latest data in Zabbix shows values for SNMP items and the syslog item

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 4/5 curl -X POST http://<api>:8000/webhooks/zabbix … then look at records/alert-<eventid>.json

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 5 → a real trigger fires and the record + card appear
